newsitem.title: USA: Edison nuclear unit seen down until March.
newsitem.headline: Edison nuclear unit seen down until March.

text.p: The 1,070 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the San Onofre nuclear power plant in southern Calfornia will probably not be restarted before early March, a Southern California Edison Co spokesman said Thursday.
The unit was beginning to reheat Wednesday when a leak emerged in a tube within one of the unit's two steam generators, but the extent of the problem remains uncertain.
"We won't know exactly what's going on until we get inside the generator," the spokesman noted.
Edison expects to have the problem assessed by Monday.

The nuclear unit's restart had already been delayed by about two weeks for extra tube repair work and is "unlikely" to be resumed by the end of February as called for by the latest operating schedule, the spokesman said.
